description:
Replace the three TUI-specific handlers with registered Tracer handlers and remove their dedicated CLI flags.

Modules to fold:
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/event_logger.ex` → `:tui_events` (stdin bytes, key events)
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/agent_telemetry_logger.ex` → `:tui_agent` (session/turn/tool lifecycle)
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/tracer.ex` → `:tui_raw` (15 TTY pipeline events: reader, raw_mode, drain)

In `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`:
- Remove `--debug-events`, `--trace=PATH`, `--telemetry=PATH` flag handling
- The unified `--log-telemetry=PATH` / `--no-telemetry` / `--list-telemetry` flags (wired in task 1) replace all three

Note: `:tui_raw` is high-frequency (stdin byte level). Its description should call this out so users know to expect volume.
title: Fold TUI telemetry handlers into Tracer
